newsitem.title: GERMANY: Berentzen says 96 sales up 22 pct.
newsitem.headline: Berentzen says 96 sales up 22 pct.

text.p: German wine and spirits maker Berentzen Group said on Wednesday its sales excluding tax rose 22 percent to 558 million marks ($338.1 million) in 1996.

Net profit, dampened in 1996 by costs relating to the acquisition of the Strohmann Brennereien distillery and by the closing of a facility in Goch, would fall slightly below the 1995 level of 33.6 million marks, Berentzen said.
Net profit in 1995 was also boosted by 4.9 million marks in extraordinary income.

The company said it expected the integration of Strohmann Brennereien, Okertalker Mineralbrunnen and CW Tasche to result in sales and profit to increases in 1997, despite Germany's weak consumer climate.
